Subject: Incubator stipend — request for conditional top-up consideration

Can Redwood provide a one-time top-up or an extended trial window for Moonshot Labs? We’re in the middle of mentor demo week and the extra credits would be the difference in getting a customer pilot signed before the end of the month.

I attached a quick usage snapshot so you can see the spike. If there are hoops (SOW or PO) we can loop procurement.

Thanks —

Chloe / Karthik —

Quick internal note after looking at the usage snapshot: Moonshot spiked ~3.7x above their cohort norm for two days. Two options I would support: 1) a 30-day extension to the cohort stipend at the same nominal rate OR 2) a fixed one-time top-up of $5k credits, with an explicit milestone trigger (signed pilot/PO by 31 Jul).

Preference: top-up tied to milestone so we avoid indefinite open-ended extensions. We should require a procurement contact if legal wants SOW language. Ben — anything from finance on one-off credits (accounting memo / write-off)?

-Marissa
Sr. Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incubator stipend — request for conditional top-up consideration

Ari —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Based on your snapshot and our programs guidance, Redwood can offer the following, conditional on procurement/milestone confirmation:

- One-time credit top-up equal to $5,000 of usage credits (applied immediately)
- Top-up is contingent on Moonshot Labs either signing a pilot commitment (simple PO/SOW) or demonstrating a binding customer pilot agreement by 31 Jul 2026
- If the milestone is not met by 31 Jul, we will withdraw the top-up and roll back any applied credits (we will provide notice 7 days before reversal)

I attached the proposed credit schedule and the SOW template for procurement. If procurement needs a DocuSign template, we can send that too. Please share the procurement contact and we’ll get legal/finance looped.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Partnerships — Startup Programs, Redwood Inference

Thanks Chloe — that structure works. Procurement is looped (procurement@moonshotlabs.com) and our contracts lead is on this thread. We’ll aim to have a signed PO or confirmation of the pilot customer by 29 Jul.

One small ask from legal: can the credit top-up be explicitly non-transferable and expire if not used within 60 days of issuance? Happy to accept that in writing. Also — can you send the DocuSign link for the SOW so we can expedite?

Appreciate the help.

—Ari

Subject: Approval: one-time credit top-up (Moonshot Labs) — finance sign-off

Chloe / Marissa —

I reviewed the request and approve a one-time $5k credit top-up under the following guardrails:
1) Credit is non-transferable and will expire 60 days after issuance.
2) Top-up will be applied immediately upon a signed PO or a signed customer pilot confirmation; if the milestone is not met by 31 Jul 2026 we will issue a reversal notice and reclaim the credits.
3) We will document the write-off in the August revenue adjustments and tag to DEAL-7843.

Chloe — please proceed to send the DocuSign SOW template and the signed credit schedule once procurement confirms.

Thanks,
